items.title: 53566_Benjamin F.
items.q: And "Scenic designs by Joseph L. Hall, Costumes designed by Johnny Jones." Is there anybody else in that cast or in the other credits that is anybody we should know about? Or...

ctx.x: Zelda Jackson...uh, uh, Zelda Anderson was Rochester's sister, and her and her brother did act... This is her brother. We had 'em doin' man 'n' wife, you know, in... Dave Anderson, see. And they sang a song, "On Accounta You," and "You caused me to be so blue you broke my heart..." and so forth. They did that number together, you know, and she was mad at him 'cause he had left her and ever'thing. But they brother and sister.
And "Scenic designs by Joseph L. Hall, Costumes designed by Johnny Jones." Is there anybody else in that cast or in the other credits that is anybody we should know about? Or...

I don't remember these...this is a white boy and girl that made the costumes for... They were students over at U.S.C. And some way they contacted Clarence Muse, and they come over and made all of our costumes for us. They were students over there, you know, and they...they were...oh, this is what I'm talkin' about--Mazie Younkers and Ann Powell--but one of 'em was a boy. They made our costumes for us.
